absent: Actual trace event payload layouts, probe points and call sites for mce, memcg, migrate, mmap, module, napi and netfs are not present.
Numeric values of GFP bits, page flags, VMA flags, zone types, LRU ids, migrate modes, compaction enums and taint bits are not present.
Locking rules, concurrency constraints and calling contexts for the traced operations are not present.
Bodies for netfs collect contig, donate and folio queue trace tables are not present in the routed part.
Implementations of tracing primitives such as enumeration registration, flag printing and event definition are not present.

findings.text: Trace subsystem names are fixed per header: mce, memcg, migrate, mmap, mmap_lock, module, napi and netfs each select the tracing group under which that header events appear.
Memory failure tracing belongs to the ras subsystem while its include file identity stays memory-failure, separating file identity from subsystem identity.

Each trace header provides a distinct single inclusion guard so repeated inclusion has no effect, with one guard per file across mce, memcg, memory failure, migrate, mmap, mmap lock, module, napi and netfs.

Memory failure action reporting defines four outcomes identified by MF_RECOVERED and MF_IGNORED plus MF_FAILED and MF_DELAYED, distinguishing successful recovery and skipped handling from unsuccessful and deferred handling.

Memory failure page classification provides a vocabulary distinguishing unknown fallback, already poisoned and poison acquisition, unmapping failure, reserved and high order kernel pages, huge and free huge and unsplit transparent huge pages, buddy and dax and non struct page pfns, dirty and clean swapcache, and dirty clean truncated mlocked and unevictable LRU variants.

Enumeration to label tables use a two phase helper pattern where an early phase only registers enumeration values with tracing and a later phase builds value plus label pairs for display, with a distinct terminator form for the final entry that avoids a trailing separator. The same pattern appears for memory failure, migrate and general memory flag tables.

Page migration tracing defines three modes for async, light synchronous and full synchronous operation, and eleven reasons covering damon and demotion, compaction and contiguous range work, memory failure and hotplug, syscall or cpuset initiation, mbind policy, misplaced NUMA pages, long term pinning and a never migrated marker.
A helper declares mmap lock trace events from a single name, producing events that carry the address space pointer and a boolean indicating write versus read locking.

The GFP display set is composed from a fixed general part plus optional KASAN related entries plus an optional lockdep entry. When the corresponding support is unavailable the optional part contributes nothing, otherwise it contributes its skip or no lockdep entries.

General GFP tracing covers zone and placement selection, mobility and reclaimability, high memory handling, direct and background reclaim behavior, input output and filesystem interaction, zeroing and zero tag handling, write intent, warning suppression, retry and failure semantics, memalloc context and its negation, compound pages, hardwall enforcement, node locality and accounting.

GFP rendering pairs each numeric flag value with its textual name and combines composite preset names with per bit entries into one table terminated by a zero plus null sentinel. A display helper shows the set as a pipe separated list, or the word none when no bits are set. An earlier phase records GFP bit positions as enumeration values.

Page flag rendering maps each page flag bit position to its short name, covering dirty plus locking and waiter states, reference and freshness tracking, LRU membership with active and working set hints, owner and architecture slots, reserved and private markers, writeback and reclaim and swap backing, head pages, unevictable and drop behind policy, RCU free handling, and conditional mlocked, hardware poison, idle, young and extra architecture entries. A display helper shows pipe separated names or none when empty.

Optional page flag names expand to a bit plus name pair only when the corresponding feature is configured, otherwise they expand to nothing so the display table omits those bits without gaps. This applies to mlocked, hardware poison, idle and young, and two extra architecture flags.

VMA flag rendering maps each area flag to a short readable name covering permissions and may permissions, sharing and mapping kinds, growth and guard behavior, userfaultfd missing minor write protection and remote write protection states, locking and fault locking, input output and sync, sequential versus random hints, copy fork expand and dump controls, accounting and reserve policy, hugetlb and huge page preference, soft dirty and mixed map tracking, droppable and mergeable states, plus one architecture slot. A display helper shows pipe separated names or none when empty.

The architecture specific VMA slot has four mutually exclusive spellings selected by build configuration, so exactly one label occupies that position in any build. Soft dirty, userfaultfd minor and protection, and droppable entries are likewise present only when their features are configured and otherwise vanish.

Compaction tracing defines lifecycle outcomes covering contended and deferred and skipped cases, continued and successful progress, partially skipped and completed termination, and unsuitable page or zone selection, plus three priority levels for full synchronous and light synchronous and asynchronous work, plus three numeric feedback codes for failed and withdrawn and progress.

Result to feedback mapping reports complete as failed, success as progress, and every other compaction result as withdrawn. When compaction support is disabled the status, priority and feedback tables are all defined empty so no enumeration entries are emitted.

Zone tracing names Normal and Movable in all builds, plus DMA and DMA32 and HighMem only when that zone exists. LRU tracing names unevictable plus inactive and active file and inactive and active anonymous lists.

Module taint display renders a flag word as a compact letter string where unsigned and proprietary and forced and out of tree and staging states each map to a distinct single letter with no separator between letters.
NAPI tracing uses a fixed placeholder label to indicate absence of an associated network device.

Network filesystem initiation tracing distinguishes write begin and prefetch, single and gap handling, readahead and page reads, plus expanded and direct paths on reads, and through plus unbuffered plus direct writes plus cache copy and single and general writeback on writes. Request origins further separate cache copy, direct and unbuffered paths, readahead and single and gap and page reads, write intent reads, and single general and through writeback. Subrequest sources separate zero fill and cache access, server download and upload, plus invalid and unknown markers.

Network filesystem request and subrequest tracing follows assessment, collection and recollection, submission and resubmission, progress and completion, pause wake and wait transitions, abandonment cancellation and termination, donation splitting and merging, plus failure points for read write and preparation stages, reference get put and see operations, and folio freshness prefetch whole modification streaming flush allocation and clearing transitions.
